rows.grounds: compound: ṣaṭ-kāraṇa-ṣaḍ-ātmatvāt (abl. sg. of -ātmatva, 'because of being of the nature of six causes') + ṣaṭtriṃśat-tattva-yojanam (nom./acc. sg., 'application of the thirty-six principles'); Tantraloka 15.260
compound loc. sg.: ṣoḍhā-mahā-nyāse ('in the great sixfold nyāsa'); Tantraloka 15.260
past passive participle, loc. sg. neuter (locative absolute); Tantraloka 15.260
viśvam (nom./acc. sg. neuter, 'universe') + idam (nom./acc. sg. neuter, 'this') joined by sandhi; Tantraloka 15.260
indeclinable ablative adverb ('by force, suddenly'); Tantraloka 15.260
